### problem_chain

Root problem (the customer's ask, persona: "You want to cancel Juniper's grooming pass and get back whatever money is left on it"): cancel the prepaid pass `46af6b5f-2f51-4c76-b84a-4e702d03d175` (Full Groom Pass 6-Visit, status active) with its refund → policy `groom_ext_pass_cancel_refund`, target `cancel_groom_pass_241c8b1d` (owner=user).

Walk from the root rule:
- Prerequisite sentence in the root's own rule: "The refund on a cancelled pass is fixed only after every cancellation on the pass that is recorded with a fee remedy carries its late-cancellation fee entry." (state form).
- Is it true at 2026-10-05? groom_events of the pass with event_type `groom_appointment_cancel` and `late_cancel_remedy` = fee: only `012804fb-56b7-41c5-ba64-57d59e57f4d1` (original_event_id `925cea80-…`). There is no `groom_late_cancel_fee` row anywhere in the seed (13 groom_events rows: 5 book, 2 complete, 2 no-show, 2 cancel, 1 redo, …none of type groom_late_cancel_fee). The other cancellation `a245cfba-…` has remedy `none` and is not in the condition. → FALSE at the opening.
- Which write brings it about: reading the other policies' rules, `groom_ext_pass_late_cancel_fee` says "On a prepaid pass a late cancellation carries the pass late-cancellation fee worked out under this rule, booked to the pass as a late-cancellation fee entry for the cancelled booking." — the pass is a Full Groom Pass (prepaid), so the club rule ("Groom Club Monthly only") is excluded by its own scope sentence. Resolving action: `charge_late_cancel_fee_38a40f67` (owner=agent).
- Its own rule carries no prerequisite sentence (`prerequisite: []`), and none of its inputs is false-gated. Tree ends.

Derived tree: nodes {P1 = pass late-cancellation fee (agent), R = pass cancel + refund (user)}; edge R ← P1, kind value_input (the fee amount enters the refund through `fees_booked` and the entry count through `fee_entries`/`fee_share`). n = 1 prerequisite problem, value_input edges = 1 ≥ max(0,1) = 1. Acyclic. Topological order: P1 then R. One problem (R) is the customer's own write (owner=user), handed over.

Load-bearing run (skip P1, everything else unchanged): refund on the opening world = 385.56 … − 7.50 − 0 = 115.665 (half-up 115.67; the DSL's float round prints 115.66) versus 112.81 with the fee booked. The edge bears weight.

Parallel edges: none (one edge).

Tool layer does not judge the prerequisite: `cancel_groom_pass_241c8b1d` body reads the pass, sets status cancelled / visits_remaining 0 and creates a `groom_pass_refund` row with the amount passed; it reads no `groom_late_cancel_fee` row and refuses nothing. `charge_late_cancel_fee_38a40f67` creates one row with the amount passed; no check.

Persona and the tree: the persona raises only the root problem. One conditional line exists: "If the agent explains that some charge has to go on the pass before the cancellation can be worked out, you sigh, say that is fair enough and tell them to go ahead; you do not argue it." It is triggered only by the agent's own explanation and supplies nothing the agent has not already said; it does not name the fee, its amount or the cancellation it is for, and the customer never asks "do I need to sort something out first". Not a short-circuit (recorded as an observation O0-1). Other asks in the persona: "refunded to your card" — answered by the rule ("the refund goes to the original payment"); not an extra item of work. Persona closes on the agent's confirmation that the pass is cancelled and the refund is going back — the last write.

Now/wait/refuse: act now. Base `groom_pass_cancel_refund`: "The pass status is active or suspended when the cancellation is requested." → active. Only the customer can cancel → owner=user hand-over; persona: "you would rather do that step yourself".

Step 1 — `charge_late_cancel_fee_38a40f67`(groom_pass_id=`46af6b5f-…`, original_event_id=`925cea80-ed02-4663-aef9-ebfd96d875a3` (the booking, per the docstring "the booking entry itself, not the cancellation entry"), amount_usd=**5.71**). Handling time: opening world.
- base_fee = late_cancel_fee_usd (Full Groom Pass 6-Visit) = 20.00
- add-on: cancelled booking `925cea80-…` addon_code deshed_treatment → 50% × addon_deshed_usd 25.00 = 12.50
- slot: appointment 2026-10-03 is a Saturday (DAYS(2024-01-06, 2026-10-03) % 7 = 0; persona "this past Saturday morning") → weekend 1.25
- fee basis = (20 + 12.5) × 1.25 = 40.625
- notice: cancellation `012804fb-…` notice_hours 15; free_cancel_notice_hours 24; 15 ≥ 12 (half) → prorate: 40.625 × (24 − 15)/24 = 15.234375
- repeat: missed bookings on the pass dated within the last 6 whole calendar months before 2026-10-05 (MONTHS(d, today) in [0,6), i.e. on/after 2026-04-05): no-show `f7bd351c-…` 2026-06-27 (in), no-show `807b8ae0-…` 2026-03-14 (out — 6 whole months+; near-miss), cancellation `a245cfba-…` 2026-08-12 remedy none (excluded by "cancellations recorded with no remedy are not missed bookings"; near-miss), cancellation `012804fb-…` 2026-10-02 fee (in, "the cancellation now being charged included") → 2 → ×1.5 → 22.8515625
- Plus relief: member_memberships `a9490d09-…` Tailwise Plus Annual, status active → 25%
- clinic relief: vet_plans `68dfb0b3-…` (pet Juniper) status active; latest office visit `34dba081-…` 2026-09-24 (telehealth `7fd1f88b-…` 2026-10-02 excluded: "telehealth consultations, wellness exams and other services are not office visits" — near-miss; wellness_exam 2026-03-02 excluded); gap 2026-09-24 → 2026-10-03 = 9 days, 2 < 9 ≤ 14 → 50%
- combined relief = min(100, 25 + 50) = 75 → 22.8515625 × 0.25 = 5.712890625 → **5.71**
- Opening-world contrast: this problem is evaluated on the opening world, so the two coincide.

Step 2 — `cancel_groom_pass_241c8b1d`(groom_pass_id=`46af6b5f-…`, refund_usd=**112.81**), owner=user, handed to the customer with the pass id and figure. Handling time: after step 1.
- full-refund window: purchased 2025-11-20, today 2026-10-05 → far beyond 14 days → partial refund.
- paid_rate = 385.56 / 6 = 64.26
- used visits (complete/no-show/forfeit with visits_delta 1): completes `1d4757e1-…`, `d09bffa0-…`; no-shows `807b8ae0-…`, `f7bd351c-…` → 4 (consistent with visits_remaining 2)
